---
name: incident-postmortem
description: Run a blameless postmortem after an outage.
when_to_use: After a production incident, when someone asks what went wrong, who was paged, or how to stop it happening again.
---

# Incident postmortem

## Timeline
Build a timeline from alerts, chat logs and deploys: detection, response, mitigation,
resolution.

## Causes
Ask why until you reach a systemic cause. Name contributing factors, not people.

## Actions
Each follow-up gets an owner and a date. Prefer fixes that remove a class of failure over
reminders to be careful.
